test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

After the severe bus accident, they tried to identify the victims, but the bodies were too manlged to be investigated.
solution:
The correct answer is '**manlged**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct spelling** of'manlged' is '**mangled**'.
 
• The word '**mangled**' means '**to damage something so badly that it is difficult to see what it looked like originally**'.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**manlged**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Investigated**- to try to find out all the facts about something.
 
• **Accident**- an unpleasant event that happens unexpectedly and causes damage, injury or death.
 
• **Victims**- a person or animal that is injured, killed or hurt by somebody/something.
